findings.name: Accessibility audit scope
findings.detail: Primary navigation, reaction task and recommendation controls are keyboard-operable, and all numeric inputs have labels. Screen-reader behavior, contrast ratios and full WCAG conformance were not audited. Trend pointer tooltips do not have keyboard equivalents.
